ISEN 689 | Special Topics in... | Fall 2026
Instructor: Jihoon Jeong | jihoonjeong@tamu.edu
Meets: TR 08:00AM - 09:15AM | ETB 1013
Grading: Exam 1 [30%], Exam 2 [30%], Final Project proposal [10%], Final Project presentation [15%], Final Project final report [15%] — A: 90%-100%, B: 80%-89.99%, C: 70%-79.99%, D: 60%-69.99%, F: <60%
Topics: Gaussian Beam, Ray Optics, Wave Optics, Interference, Diffraction, Optical Detectors, Laser fundamentals, Thermal Radiometry, Process Physics, Optical Metrology, Feature Extraction from Physical Signals, Time-Series Data, Spatio-Temporal Data, System Integration, Process Control, optical sensing, laser sensing, imaging-based sensing, measurement methods, advanced manufacturing processes, in-situ process monitoring, real-time process monitoring, measurement techniques, characterization techniques, Additive Manufacturing, semiconductor manufacturing, physical principles, practical limitations, advanced sensing modalities, measurement data, manufacturing process performance, in-situ sensing strategies, monitoring strategies, key process variables, temperature, geometry, material state, process stability, sensor data analysis, process information extraction, thermal behavior, material response, process dynamics, measurement uncertainty, limitations, sources of error, optical sensing systems, laser-based sensing systems, mitigation strategies, sensing concepts, measurement concepts, real-world case studies, Sensing, Measurement
Prerequisites: Approval of instructor
